attempts.text:
**The window starts in a persistent block.** Columns 0 to 7, `degS` to `sspB`, are spine, carried by 96 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 98 to 100% of genes there, and no column hesitates more than 0.13 bits.

**Column 8 is variable**, `dcuC`, named in 95% of calls at 0.36 bits. Then columns 9 to 14, `nanR` to `nanQ`, are spine again, carried by 95 to 96% of chromosomes, named in 95 to 99.8% of calls.

**The first fork is at column 15**, `yhcG`, the most hesitant column of the window at 0.89 bits, in a region of plasticity in 35% of calls; the model names 80% there. Its branches carry a transposase and an IS1-like element transposase, each in 17% of chromosomes. Then a long spine, columns 16 to 54, `gltD` to `secG`, carried by 95 to 96% of chromosomes: the model names 65 to 99% of genes, fewest and most hesitant at column 16, `gltD`, 65% and 0.46 bits.

**Column 55 is variable**, `yhbX`, named in 93% of calls at 0.42 bits. Columns 56 to 74, `argG` to `yhbP`, are spine, carried by 92 to 96% of chromosomes, named in 96 to 98% of calls, with no column above 0.13 bits.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 75 to 79, `yhbO` to `diaA`, are carried by 52 to 66% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 3% of calls, and named in 96 to 98%. Across the window the model names 97% of genes at 0.09 bits; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.10 against 0.06 bits, and names fewer genes, 57% against 98%.

label: degS
facts:
WINDOW: the degS window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor degS, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 476 to 555 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying degS once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 97% of genes, 0.09 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 40,385 calls, named 99%, 0.04 bits; shell 2,610 calls, named 72%, 0.80 bits; cloud 125 calls, named 41%, 2.74 bits. Outside an RGP 41,788 calls, named 98%, 0.06 bits; inside an RGP 1,332 calls, named 57%, 1.10 bits. Columns: 72 spine, 2 fork, 6 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.10 against 0.06 bits) and names fewer genes (57% against 98%); 1,332 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 15 (yhcG) 0.89 bits, RGP 35%; column 16 (gltD) 0.46 bits, RGP 35%; column 55 (yhbX) 0.42 bits, RGP 0.2%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 15 (fork), RGP 35%; the least: columns 0-7 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-7 (8 columns) spine: share 96-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: degS "trypsin-like peptidase domain-conta…", degQ, zapG, zapE "cell division protein ZapE", rplM, rpsI, sspA, sspB "ClpXP protease specificity-enhancin…". named 98-100% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 6 (sspA), named 98%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.13 bits (column 6 (sspA)).
2. column 8 variable: RGP 0.4%. named 95%; 0.36 bits.
   8: dcuC S 83%
3. columns 9-14 (6 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 0.2-2%. Genes: nanR, nanA "dihydrodipicolinate synthase family…", nanT, nanE, nanK, nanQ. named 95-99.8% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 14 (nanQ), named 95%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 9 (nanR)).
4. column 15 fork: RGP 35%. named 80%; 0.89 bits.
   15: yhcG S 58% "DUF1016 N-terminal domain-containin…"; also "transposase" S 17%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 17%
5. columns 16-54 (39 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 0-35%. Genes: gltD "FAD-dependent oxidoreductase", gltB, yhcC "TIGR01212 family radical SAM protein", arcB, elbB, mtgA, yrbL "PhoP regulatory network protein YrbL", npr, rapZ, ptsN, hpf, rpoN, lptB "ABC transporter ATP-binding protein", lptA, lptC, kdsC "3-deoxy-manno-octulosonate-8-phosph…", kdsD, yrbG "calcium/sodium antiporter", mlaF, mlaE, mlaD, mlaC, mlaB "lipid asymmetry maintenance protein…", ibaG, murA, sfsB, ispB, rplU, rpmA, yhbE "DMT family transporter", cgtA, dacB, greA, yhbY "ribosome assembly RNA-binding prote…", rlmE, ftsH, folP, glmM, secG. named 65-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 16 (gltD), named 65%, 0.46 bits.
6. column 55 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 93%; 0.42 bits.
   55: yhbX S 86% "phosphoethanolamine transferase"
7. columns 56-74 (19 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 0.2-1%. Genes: argG, rimP, nusA, infB, rbfA, truB, rpsO, pnp, nlpI, yrbN "protein YrbN", deaD, mtr, yhbW "MsnO8 family LLM class oxidoreducta…", ubiV "U32 family peptidase", ubiU, ubiT, yhbS "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase", yhbQ "DNA damage response exodeoxyribonuc…", yhbP "YhbP family protein". named 96-98% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 68 (yhbW), named 96%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.13 bits (column 56 (argG)).
8. columns 75-79 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 1-3%. named 96-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 78, named 96%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.11 bits (column 79).
   75 variable: yhbO P 66% "protein/nucleic acid deglycase"
   76 variable: yraR P 62% "NAD(P)H-binding protein"
   77 variable: yraQ P 60% "permease"
   78 variable: dolP P 57%
   79 fork: diaA P 52%; also yraN P 20%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): degQ trypsin-like peptidase domain-containin…; zapG Z-ring associated protein ZapG; sspA stringent starvation protein SspA; nanE N-acetylmannosamine-6-phosphate 2-epime…; nanQ YhcH/YjgK/YiaL family protein; gltB glutamate synthase large subunit; lptA LptA/OstA family protein; lptC LPS export ABC transporter periplasmic…; mlaF ATP-binding cassette domain-containing…; mlaE ABC transporter permease; mlaD outer membrane lipid asymmetry maintena…; mlaC phospholipid-binding protein MlaC; ubiU peptidase U32 family protein; yhcD FimD/PapC N-terminal domain-containing…; yhcA fimbria/pilus chaperone family protein
END: the window ends at column 79, diaA, in 52% of chromosomes.
